build_glm_ocr_vision_transformer: build a GlmOcrVisionTransformer to process image patches with rotary position embeddings and spatial merging
create_glm_ocr_vision_attention: create a GlmOcrVisionAttention module with QKV parallel linear, RMSNorm, and MMEncoderAttention for multimodal encoding
create_glm_ocr_vision_block: create a GlmOcrVisionBlock combining GlmOcrVisionAttention and GlmOcrVisionMLP with LayerNorm layers
build_glm_ocr_conditional_model: build a GlmOcrForConditionalGeneration model with a GlmOcrVisionTransformer visual tower for image-text inference
test_glm_ocr_vision_forward: test the GlmOcrVisionTransformer forward pass with input tensor and grid_thw to produce merged visual features
